response.rationale: A and B name the same capability. The two labels are nearly the same, differing only in "capacity management" versus "capacity planning". Both scopes contain the same domain class, RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1). That class is the whole business component in B, and in A it is the domain-layer orchestrator of community:1. A's community is broader: it also groups persistence classes such as SessionRepository (node e3915d8f30e495a9, fan-in 11) and booking, member and payment classes. Even so, both labels point at the same thing, the rink-session scheduling and capacity logic that runs through RinkService. A is seen from the persistence side and B from the domain side. Confidence is moderate, not high, because A's community covers more than session scheduling.
